summary: Zero-value supplier invoice with withholding tax flag skipped by payrun, blocking supplier netting
description:
Issue summary:
A supplier invoice submitted through the vendor portal (Solstice Labs Ltd, INV-2026-0098) has a net_amount of 0.00 because it's a credit/adjustment that only carries a withholding tax amount. The payrun engine excluded the invoice from payment because of a zero net_amount rule. As a result, the supplier's credit memo was not netted or paid out and the month-end AP aging and reconciliation are incorrect.

Impact:
- Supplier Solstice Labs is showing unpaid balance and has open dispute with Finance.
- March month-end AP aging will not match supplier statements until this is resolved.
- Potential tax reporting issues if withholding amounts are not accounted for in the GL.

Environment:
- Production AP pipeline, vendor portal (ap.redwood.internal), payrun batch PB-20260310-77, GL instance accounting-ledger-prod.
- Invoice metadata: vendor_id SL-0043, invoice INV-2026-0098, vendor_currency USD, gross_withholding_amount 120.00, net_amount 0.00, tax_code WHT-30.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Upload a vendor credit/adjustment invoice in vendor portal with zero net (line adjustments = -120.00, withholding 120.00, net = 0.00).
2) Submit to AP queue and allow automatic invoice validation to complete.
3) Trigger scheduled payrun (PB-20260310-77) or run payrun validation step.
4) Observe payrun excludes invoice due to net_amount == 0 rule.

Observed behavior / Logs:
- Payrun job log excerpt: "INFO: skipping invoice INV-2026-0098: net_amount == 0.00" (payment-engine-2026-03-10.log).
- AP queue shows invoice in 'validated' state but not in payment batch.
- GL posting not created for withholding amount; expected GL entries for withholding (2201: Withholding Payable) are missing.

Attachments / references:
- Payment batch: PB-20260310-77
- Vendor portal entry screenshot (stored in internal S3 path: s3://redwood-support/artifacts/INT-100124/portal-screenshot.png)
comments: 2026-03-10 10:35 - Aisha Patel: Filed after vendor escalation. Vendor says this is a legitimate tax-withheld credit and expects reconciliation on their statement.
2026-03-10 11:02 - Connor Diaz: Looking into payrun rules; noted skip condition on net_amount == 0. Adding logging to confirm withheld amount not posted.
2026-03-10 14:20 - FinanceOps (Maria Gomez): Confirmed supplier expects netting rather than automatic exclusion. We need GL entries for withholding and either a manual payment or credit application.

2026-03-11 09:12 - Connor Diaz: Reproduced in staging by creating similar invoice. Payment engine currently treats any invoice where net_amount <= 0 as non-payable. Withholding amounts are stored in tax table but not creating payable line item.

2026-03-12 08:45 - Engineering (J. Park): Proposed quick config change to include invoices with withholding > 0 as payable; longer-term fix requires schema change to payment lines. PR drafted: gh-accounts-payable/enable-withholding-payable
investigation_notes: Confirmed root cause: payment-engine rule skips invoices where net_amount == 0 (legacy behavior intended for pure credit memos).
Withholding amounts are captured on tax_lines but not translated into payment_lines for payrun. Payment engine expects at least one payment_line with positive amount to include invoice in payrun.

Staging reproduction successful with PB-20260311-STG test run; we can patch behavior via configuration to treat tax_lines.withholding_amount > 0 as a payment_line of that withheld amount (short-term workaround).
Risk assessment: Adding withheld amounts into payment_lines will surface small-valued payouts; need sign-off from Tax/Accounting to confirm posting and withholding remittance treatment.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-12 13:00 - Workaround implemented: FinanceOps manually created a payable for GL 2201 for 120.00 and included it in off-cycle payment run. Supplier was paid; vendor confirmed receipt.

Hotfix: Engineering deployed configuration change to payment-engine to treat invoices with withholding_amount > 0 as payable items for payrun inclusion (feature flagged). Deployed to prod under feature flag 'enable_withholding_payables'.
Follow-up tasks: (1) Tax to confirm GL treatment and remittance schedule (owner: Maria Gomez), (2) remove feature flag after validation and add unit tests to prevent regression (owner: Engineering).
Post-action: Marked for inclusion in monthly retrospective and AP runbook update.
